title: Clean up heading anchors.
description: Replace all links to headings with a lower case hyphenated version of the heading text, and ensure that all headings have an anchor link that matches the new format. This will improve the readability and consistency of the documentation, as well as make it easier for users to navigate to specific sections.
success_criteria: All links to headings use the heading text with lower case and hyphens as anchors
No quotes around any link to a heading
No text such as "on page <page number>" in any link to a heading
TOC and body links derive fragments from the same slug normalization that the target markdown headings use
All local markdown fragment links to headings resolve to an existing heading anchor in the target file
References to table captions either resolve to a preserved markdown anchor or are rewritten to a valid target
notes: In progress. Remaining failures are caused by fragment-slug mismatches for punctuation-heavy headings like input.json/report.json/CameraSettings and by unresolved Table N.M references after table captions were converted from HTML anchors to bold markdown lines.
